slides.texte_overlay:
Lost manners every man
should bring back

1. Stand up to greet people

When someone walks in,
get up. Shake their hand.
It says: you matter here.

2. Phone away at dinner

Not face down. Away.
The people at the table
came for you, not your screen.

3. Hold the door

For anyone. Man, woman, stranger.
Two seconds of your time.

4. Have something worth
talking about

Good manners need good conversation.
Read. Ask. Learn one new thing a day.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. Have something worth
talking about

Good manners need good conversation.
Learn one new thing a day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. Introduce people by name

Never leave someone standing
there like a stranger.

6. Return what you borrow
in better shape

Fuel in the car.
The book without bent pages.

7. Write a thank-you note

A real one. By hand.
People keep those for years.
